liveStream.note: No test page in extension/test-page/ or scanner/test-video-canvas/ covers a live stream (HLS/DASH/live video). video.html is a static file, canvas.html draws a playing file. Recorded as NOT COVERED — no live stream was invented.

tenThousandCustomers.note: NOT RUN — no load-test setup exists here, and hammering the live free-tier Worker + Neon would risk the real service. Needs a staged load-test plan with rate limits.

webgl.note: No test page in extension/test-page/ or scanner/test-video-canvas/ draws WebGL content. The GeckoView prototype has WebGL test pages, but the extension test pages do not. Recorded as NOT COVERED.
